scope: Installed extension real mouse and keyboard GUI acceptance; four requested areas passed within the stated boundaries.

checks.name: WFRL sidebar and home
checks.actual_interaction: Clicked the N sidebar WFRL tab, saw the WFRL workbench and selected its replay, camera and manual pages.

checks.name: MAPPO offline replay, play and pause
checks.actual_interaction: Clicked 加载 MAPPO 离线回放 and 风场全景, then clicked playback and pause. Three labeled turbines T1/T2/T3 were visible in the panorama while the sidebar was hidden. The UI showed the offline replay ready without backend; at frame 641 it displayed 127.667 s during playback, and at frame 1017 it showed 133.933 s paused. T1/T2 blade orientations visibly changed. The observer still reported frame 1017 and playing=false after a further wait. The replay was later reset to frame 1.
checks.screenshot_boundary: Saved replay screenshot shows the workbench and paused frame 1; T3 is obscured by the sidebar in this particular image. The three-turbine panorama was separately viewed through CUA.

checks.name: C1/C2/C3 comparison window and shared controls
checks.actual_interaction: Clicked 2×2 展示; the new window showed three live labeled views and a fourth static installation illustration. At frame 1017 clicked 单步: shared display advanced from 133.93 to 133.95 s. Clicked 播放 and then 暂停; all view toolbars switched together and the display reached 152.17 s. Used the window X control to close it. Reset source replay to frame 1 / 117.00 s and reopened: C1 showed blade root, C2 showed blade midsection and end, C3 showed the red-marked tip. Closed the window using its X control.
checks.view_boundary: At the separately sampled intermediate poses C2 and C3 showed ground, not blades. At the reference pose blades appeared in all three; no claim of continuous coverage or full-period visual validation.

checks.name: Independent manual scene, yaw, run and pause, return
checks.actual_interaction: Clicked 创建 / 进入手动场景. The active scene became 风机手动控制, initially paused. For T1 clicked yaw + from 0.0 to 1.0 degrees, clicked 运行 and saw the rotor and azimuth change, then clicked 暂停; UI showed T1 paused, 9 RPM and azimuth 153.7 degrees. Clicked 返回原场景 and returned to the replay scene.

evidence_images_to_retain.description: WFRL replay page, frame 1 and paused offline state; sidebar masks T3 in this image.
Actual comparison window at 117.00 s with blade root, middle and tip and static installation illustration.
Manual scene showing T1 paused, yaw 1.0 degrees and rotor angle 153.7 degrees.

evidence_method: PNG files were written by Blender Save Screenshot through visible UI. The runtime/event files were created by the parent-provided read-only observer running in the same self-owned Blender process.
limitations: UI acceptance did not test Bridge, MPI, FAST.Farm, training or network backend; no FPS, performance or scientific validity claim.
Only sampled camera poses and the stated controls were tested; no continuous view-coverage claim.

No user scene or startup file was saved, and Save Preferences was not explicitly invoked. Blender automatically saved preferences on exit; the parent restores and verifies the protected profile files.
incidental_test_state: A click while navigating the manual page changed the temporary scene target pitch hold field from 7.00 s to 7.03 s. No export or experiment was started from that field, and the self-owned test scene was discarded on exit.

shutdown.camera_observation_window: Closed via its in-window X control.
shutdown.main_window: Closed via native close button, chose Don’t Save for the self-owned Untitled.blend.
shutdown.pid_56319: Absent from ps -p 56319 after closing; parent captured normal exit code 0 in its tool output.
